title: Autonomous Multireference Quantum Chemistry with Artificial Intelligence Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.29902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurately describing chemical reactions that involve strongly correlated electrons remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. Multireference electronic structure methods can address this challenge, but their application requires expert decisions that are di!cult to automate, particularly when the electronic structure changes as chemical bonds form and break. Here we introduce CASPER, an autonomously agentic workflow that performs multireference calculations along chemical reaction pathways. CASPER combines chemical knowledge, electronic structure calculations, and iterative assessment to identify chemically meaningful active spaces and maintain their consistency as bonds form and break. We demonstrate its capabilities on five transition-metal reactions, for which CASPER generates consistent multireference potential energy profiles with minimal human intervention. translated_title: 基于人工智能智能体的自主多参考量子化学
translated_abstract: 准确描述涉及强关联电子的化学反应仍然是计算化学领域的一个重大挑战。多参考电子结构方法可以应对这一挑战，但其应用需要专家决策，而这些决策难以自动化，尤其是在化学键形成和断裂过程中电子结构发生变化的情形下。本文介绍了CASPER，这是一个自主的智能体工作流程，能够沿化学反应路径执行多参考计算。CASPER将化学知识、电子结构计算和迭代评估相结合，以识别具有化学意义的活性空间，并在键形成和断裂时保持其一致性。我们在五个过渡金属反应上展示了其能力，CASPER在最少人工干预的情况下生成了一致的多参考势能曲线。重要的是，在两个反应中，CASPER识别出关键的电子……
tldr: 本文提出CASPER，一个基于人工智能智能体的自主工作流程，能够沿化学反应路径自动执行多参考量子化学计算，在最少人工干预下为过渡金属反应生成一致的多参考势能曲线。
en_tdlr: CASPER is an autonomous AI-agent workflow that performs multireference quantum chemistry calculations along chemical reaction pathways, generating consistent multireference potential energy profiles for transition-metal reactions with minimal human intervention.
